name: Negative — integer parsing with error check
diff:
diff --git a/parser.go b/parser.go
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/parser.go
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+package main
+
+import "strconv"
+
+func parseValue(s string) (int, error) {
+	n, err := strconv.Atoi(s)
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, err
+	}
+	return n * 2, nil
+}
